positives.name: army cot
positives.enterReply: At the foot of the cot is a large, unwieldy trunk. The trunk is closed and locked with a padlock. /   / You hear a plane flying high overhead, outside the tent. /   / >get in cot / You are now in the army cot. /   / It sounds as if the plane is circling. /   / >
positives.exitReply: You are now in the army cot. /   / It sounds as if the plane is circling. /   / >get out of cot / You are on your feet again. /   / It sounds as if the plane is circling. /   / >

negatives.reply: You are on your feet again. /   / It sounds as if the plane is circling. /   / >sit on cot / This is no time for sitting down on the job, especially after what you've been through to get here! /   / It sounds as if the plane is flying off. /   / >

You are already standing, I think. /   / You can barely hear the plane. /   / >enter tent / What are those canvas walls around you? Just where do you think you are? Maybe I should send for Craige, eh? /   / The sound of something heavy landing comes from nearby. /   / >

Stuck in the sand, handle down, is a small pick axe. / Half buried in the sand, in the corner of the tent, is a shovel. /   / >get pickaxe / Taken. /   / >enter pickaxe / That would involve quite a contortion! /   / >

notes: army cot (51) confirmed (start in cot; GET OUT OF COT / GET IN COT). SIT ON COT is refused ('no time for sitting down') -> Sit is a wrong offer on the cot; GET IN is right. 'enter tent' refused while in the tent; 'enter pickaxe' refused. wooden beam (104), mast hole (108), altar (199), barge (211) are far into the game (walkthrough steps 100-230) -> INCOMPLETE. mast hole and altar look like non-enterable carriers by name; unverified.
method: headless Chromium play.html, Input.Inject ordinary commands, ~1.3s wait; parent via ZRamReader.objectLinks(ZRamProvider.getMem(), WorldModel.lastPayload.playerId). reply = last 10 BufferLines after the command (may include preceding turn text).
